messages:
alex: Quick Q — where do I find per-dedicated-pool metrics + autoscaling graphs? I'm debugging pool-prod-eu-4 which kept scaling but latency still spiked. Need metric names, dashboard links, and any recommended alert tuning. thanks.

jamie: :eyes: Dashboard -> Platform / Dedicated Pools -> Pool Detail. Grafana: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/pools/pool-detail?var-pool=pool-prod-eu-4. Key metrics to look at: redwood_pool_gpu_utilization, redwood_pool_pending_requests_total, redwood_pool_pending_rate (per-min delta), redwood_pool_queue_latency_ms, redwood_autoscaler_desired_replicas. Metrics are labeled by pool=<pool_name> and model_id when applicable.

alex: thanks. Is pending_requests_total the best saturation signal or should we rely on queue_latency + gpu_util?

jamie: Prefer a composite signal — pending_rate (growth) + sustained GPU util. In practice we use: pending_rate > X AND avg_gpu_util > 80% for 5m. There's also a 'saturation index' panel in the dashboard that combines these (weighted). Avoid single instantaneous util thresholds.

sophia: Runbook reminder: if saturation index > 0.7 for 10m we trigger fallback to burst-capacity policy. Runbook: https://internal.redwood/runbooks/dedicated-pool-saturation. Also check the autoscaler event timeline in the same Grafana dash.

ryan: FYI current alert "PoolHighUtilization" is gpu_util > 90% for 3m which is noisy for onboarding. Proposal: change to composite alert: (avg_gpu_util > 85% over 5m AND pending_rate > 8/min) OR (queue_latency_p50 > 500ms for 5m). I'll open a PR to adjust and add rate-based suppression.

alex: Where do we pull per-replica logs to correlate request_ids? Need to check whether specific model is causing queuing.

jamie: For logs: kubectl -n redwood-dedicated logs -l pool=pool-prod-eu-4 -c runtime --since=1h  OR via Loki: {pool="pool-prod-eu-4"} |~ "request_id". Kibana discover: https://kibana.redwood.ai/app/discover#/?q=pool:pool-prod-eu-4. Use model_id label to filter.

sophia: :thumbsup: Autoscaler graph link: https://grafana.redwood.ai/d/pools/autoscaler?var-pool=pool-prod-eu-4 — shows desired vs actual replicas and recent scale events. Also check 'replica_stall_count' panel if scales didn't complete.

ryan: Opened PR #482 to update alerting to the composite rule and to add a 10min auto-suppress window if scale actions are in-flight. Tagging @oncall for approval + any SRE feedback. ETA deploy: tomorrow 12:00 PT.

oncall-bot: Incident bot: alert-change request created by ryan. Approvals required: eng-sre, platform leads. Link: https://internal.redwood/incidents/changes/482

alex: One more question — are request queues per-model or per-pool? We saw a single hot model causing most queueing.

jamie: Queue is implemented per-pool. Metrics include model_id label so you can break down top contributing models via the 'Top queue by model' panel on the pool detail dash.

ryan: If folks agree I'll set the alert to: (pending_rate > 8/min AND avg_gpu_util > 85% over 5m) OR (queue_latency_p50 > 500ms for 5m). Also adding a cooldown: suppress alerts while a scale-up is occurring (desired_replicas != actual_replicas).

alex: :+1: please add a line in the runbook about who to page for dedicated capacity (platform oncall) and include the Grafana/Kibana quick-links.

sophia: Done — updated runbook with links and the short how-to for hunting queues and opening a capacity ticket. Cheers.
